# Version 4.153.0
> **Skia m153 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.153.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.300/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 renderer with current upstream correctness fixes. Linux font fallback may select a different face after this engine update; applications needing deterministic selection should specify or bundle their typeface.

## Breaking Changes

- **Linux font fallback may select a different face** — Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path. Applications that depend on an exact fontconfig fallback face may see different glyphs or metrics; specify an explicit family and style, or bundle the required typeface. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m153** — Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 153 and includes subsequent upstream m153 servicing and correctness fixes. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826), [#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927), [#5062](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5062), [#5116](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5116))
